programme.title: Laila
programme.desc: As a young boy, Deshraj was sent away for higher studies in order to protect him from a rival family's wrath. But upon his return, he falls in love with a girl who is the daughter of the same enemy.

programme.title: Koyelaanchal
programme.desc: An honest IAS officer rises against the atrocities of a brutal mafioso. In retaliation, the mafioso sends a deadly human weapon to kill the officer, who instead ends up abducting his child.

programme.title: Drishyam
programme.desc: When the disappearance of a policewoman's son threatens to ruin Vijay's family, he leaves no stone unturned in order to shield his family.

programme.title: The Real Hunter
programme.desc: To fuel his political ambitions, Vijay's father fixes his marriage with an affluent girl. However, after Vijay falls for an ordinary villager and plans on marrying her, his father plans to stop him.

programme.title: Alag
programme.desc: Tejas, an odd boy who grew up in a basement, is moved to a rehabilitation centre after his father's death. When he starts displaying psychic powers, a scientist abducts him for experimentation.

programme.title: Hatya: The Murder
programme.desc: Ravi's father, Ratan, gets killed when he refuses to sell his land to Murugan, a wealthy businessman. Later, Ravi sets out to avenge the death of his father.

programme.title: Farz
programme.desc: Gopal, a secret agent, investigates the death of his colleague who possessed evidence against a known terrorist. Gopal and Kamla embark on a journey to find the traitor.

programme.title: Majaal
programme.desc: Vijay falls in love with Sadhana and marries her, but on several occasions, he is disrespected by his in-laws. Frustrated, he loses interest in his married life.

programme.title: Sahadev
programme.desc: An infamous and merciless contract killer percolates through the illegal arms business by taking up the occupation of a cotton farmer.

programme.title: Ek Aur Bhool Bhulaiyaa
programme.desc: Nakulan and his family move into his supposedly haunted ancestral property. However, when his cousin starts behaving uncharacteristically, Nakulan enlists the help of his psychiatrist friend.

programme.title: Race
programme.desc: Two stepbrothers own a huge stud farm and a horse racing business. When they learn that they have a common love interest, one of them tries to kill the other and inherit the insurance money.

programme.title: Ek Aur Hero The Dashing
programme.desc: After the death of their eldest brother, Babloo and the other three brothers develop hatred towards women. However, things take a turn when Babloo falls in love with Pooja.

programme.title: Krishna Arjun
programme.desc: Sharda Yadav, a widow, lives with her two sons, Krishna and Arjun. Arjun is studying in Mumbai when he hears that his mother has passed away and Krishna has been arrested for raping a widow.

programme.title: Mast
programme.desc: Kittu is madly in love with Malika, an actress, and travels to her house in Mumbai from Pune after his father scolds him for his decreasing exam scores.

programme.title: Hiraasat
programme.desc: ACP Ashok Saxena is an honest middle-class police officer who lives with his wife, Shobha, and college-going brother, Rajesh. However, he is framed in a case of drug-trafficking and gets arrested.

programme.title: Kaun Kare Kurbanie
programme.desc: Honest and upright, Inspector Arjun is very different from his happy-go-lucky younger brother Ajit. Their relationship hits rocky ground after Ajit is accused of murder.

programme.title: Dhadkan
programme.desc: Anjali and Dev are in love with each other and plan to marry, but her family gets her married to Ram. Years later, Dev shows up to reunite with Anjali, however, she has fallen in love with Ram.

programme.title: Guddu Ki Gun
programme.desc: Guddu, a salesman, lands in dire trouble when his girlfriend's grandfather casts a spell on him for cheating on her. However, he must find true love to get rid of the curse.

programme.title: Ek Lahoo
programme.desc: Ashok and Lakshmi share an ideal brother-sister relationship. They find their perfect matches and lead a happily married life until Ashok's wife's aunt comes into their life and creates mayhem.

programme.title: Dharmyudh
programme.desc: A successful man tries to reconnect with his old teacher only to find out that she is in deep trouble. Upon learning this, he decides to do everything he can to save her.

programme.title: Aakhri Ghulam
programme.desc: Bheema, his father Dinu and generations of their family have been slaves of the wealthy Thakurs. One day, he challenges their authority and invites trouble for himself in the process.

programme.title: 16 December
programme.desc: Four Indian Revenue Service officers are assigned to intercept and arrest a group of Pakistani terrorists. The terrorists plot to detonate a nuclear bomb in New Delhi and the IRS must stop them.

programme.title: Juaari
programme.desc: Vijay, a young man, resorts to gambling in order to free his lover, Anita, who is held captive by Sanga. He soon runs out of luck when he gets arrested.

programme.title: Insaniyat
programme.desc: In order to combat terrorism, Inspector Amar has to convince two local crime lords, divided by religion, to work together. He also learns that being an honest cop has its own price.

programme.title: Josh
programme.desc: Max, who lives with his twin sister Shirley in Goa, is enraged when he finds out that she has fallen in love with Rahul, his bitter rival Prakash's younger brother.

programme.title: Kaali Topi Laal Roomaal
programme.desc: Commando Vijay arrests a terrorist, Master DD. However, he realises that Master DD is just a pawn and tries to find the real culprit.

programme.title: 100 Days of Love
programme.desc: Despite their strained history as children, a columnist falls in love with his schoolmate when they meet after years. Just as he decides to win her heart, he learns that she is engaged to another man.

programme.title: Prithipal Singh...A Story
programme.desc: Disappointed with his Olympic bronze medal, Prithipal Singh quits hockey and joins a university. However, things get worse for him when he is accused of murdering a student.

programme.title: Karishma Kudrat Ka
programme.desc: Widower Vijay lives in a village with his family. He unwittingly makes an enemy in Lala and a bandit, Bhagad, who conspire and throw him out of the village. But Vijay soon returns as a changed man.

programme.title: Avinash
programme.desc: Avinash, a singer and a dealer of stolen goods, finds his life turned upside down when some goons break into his house and assault his fiancee.

programme.title: Alag
programme.desc: Tejas, an odd boy who grew up in a basement, is moved to a rehabilitation centre after his father's death. When he starts displaying psychic powers, a scientist abducts him for experimentation.

programme.title: Jungle
programme.desc: Anu and Siddhu are in love and Siddhu turns up when Anu's family camps in a tiger sanctuary for a holiday. Unexpectedly, a sandalwood smuggler takes several members as hostages.

programme.title: Yes Boss
programme.desc: Rahul's boss Siddharth is a womaniser who blackmails Rahul into helping him win over Seema. But Rahul ends up falling in love with Seema and is torn between his career aspirations and his sweetheart.

programme.title: Payback
programme.desc: The lives of an architect and his wife are turned upside down when a stranger kidnaps their daughter and blackmails them to do some crimes for him.

programme.title: Powerfull Yoddha
programme.desc: Chandu is very passionate about kickboxing and his life revolves around his mother and his girlfriend. His life is shattered when his dying mother asks him to meet his estranged father Raghuveer.

programme.title: Dhongee
programme.desc: Chandran lies to his boss that his mother is unwell to get a leave but gets caught. In order to save his job, he is forced to pretend to his boss that he has a good-for-nothing twin brother.

programme.title: Aaj Ka Mahaatma
programme.desc: Randhir, a straightforward and hardworking man, sets out to avenge the death of his twin brother Ranvir, a criminal, who was murdered by a prison inmate.

programme.title: Falak
programme.desc: Ramnath, a watchman, is killed while stopping his corrupt bosses from committing a crime. Years later, his sons decide to exact revenge against his murderers.

programme.title: Farz
programme.desc: Gopal, a secret agent, investigates the death of his colleague who possessed evidence against a known terrorist. Gopal and Kamla embark on a journey to find the traitor.

programme.title: Shehzaade
programme.desc: Suraj, a justice-loving man, must face a series of obstacles when he discovers his widowed mother's affair with a former prisoner.

programme.title: 15th August
programme.desc: Nagpal kills Chaudhry and his son, Ram, a military officer. Chaudhry's second son, Vikram, vows to destroy Nagpal who is all set to become the Chief Minister on the upcoming Indian Independence Day.

programme.title: Ghatak
programme.desc: When Kashi visits a community with his father, he is shocked to see the torturous regime of Katya. He tries to oppose Katya, but ends up compromising the safety of his family and relatives.

programme.title: Zindagi Gulzar Hai
programme.desc: Kashaf, a young woman raised by a single mother, faces a lot of class and gender bias while growing up. However, her life turns around when she meets Zaroon in college.

programme.title: Azad Desh Ka Andha Kanoon
programme.desc: A brash and honest policeman is torn apart between his duties and saving his family when his own brother is caught in a blue-film scam. He also must protect a sole witness whose life is in danger.

programme.title: Rustum
programme.desc: ACP Abhishek Bhargav is determined to find the culprits behind the death of his friend, DCP Bharath. His investigation takes him to Bangalore, where he uncovers revelations of an organ trade mafia.

programme.title: Pyar Ke Kabil
programme.desc: Kiran and Jyoti are twins who were separated after their parents uncoupled. Years later, they meet accidentally at a picnic and decide to exchange places in an effort to reunite their parents.

programme.title: Barah Aana
programme.desc: Three men accidentally stumble into the world of crime when they start kidnapping for small ransoms in order to improve their lifestyles. However, they soon realise that it is not a bad business.

programme.title: Krishna Arjun

programme.title: Mela

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin is convinced his mojo was in a cap he gave away in 'Mojo Missing', then in 'Who's The Animal', Alvin finds himself mistaken for a Tasmanian devil during a costume visit to the zoo. (S1, ep 12)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Brittany is preparing a class speech on inner beauty in 'Suck Toad', then in 'Secret Admirer', Alvin believes that Kevin has a secret crush on one of the Chipettes. (S2, ep 11)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The boys build a treehouse in the backyard and move out in 'Independence Day', and in 'Opposites Attract', an invention of Simon's accidently magnetizes Alvin and Simon to each other. (S3, ep 11)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave is awarded for an award that is not what he thinks it is in 'Granny Awards', then in 'Sick Day', Alvin and Kevin pretend to be sick to miss school and visit the Dagarack Convention. (S4, ep 11)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon's game launch is disrupted by Jeanette's changes in 'The Return of Thornbergaupht', then in 'Squashed', Alvin ropes Dave into playing squash. (S5, ep 10)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore is desperate to land the part of the monster in the school play in 'Clowning Around', then in 'Bully For You', Simon builds a homemade robot bodyguard. (S1, ep 8)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin dresses Theodore like a baby to impress the girl of his dreams in 'Baby Whisperer', then in 'Let's Make A Deal', making a present for Dave, Alvin creates a snowball effect of chaos. (S2, ep 6)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin and Brittany learn parenting isn't easy in 'Baby Mama Drama', then in 'Ballet Boys', when Alvin's soccer team struggles, the coach makes the team learn ballet to help their skills. (S3, ep 5)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Safety Third: When Dave refuses to let Alvin get a toy sports car, Alvin secretly convinces Simon to build him an exact replica. But will Alvin be able to keep this secret from Dave? (S1, ep 27)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Crystal Ball Birthday: Annie and Amber offer to plan Brittany's birthday party, pitting her against Jeanette and Eleanor in the process. (S4, ep 12b)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Members Only: Alvin helps the "mathletes" stand up to the school bullies. But in the process, they become bullies themselves. (S2, ep 3)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Missing Miss Smith: When Alvin finally pushes Miss Smith too far, she quits. Unfortunately, her replacement is a nightmare. Now, Alvin has to do whatever it takes to get her back.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin and Simon have a secret club in 'Mysterions', and in 'The Crow That Ate My Homework', Dave promises to take Alvin to a park if he gets a good grade on his test, but a crow steals it. (S4, ep 4)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin's too short for a new amusement park ride in 'U-Fly', then in 'Yeti or Not', Alvin convinces Theodore there's a Yeti nearby, making life miserable for the rest of the family. (S5, ep 3)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore's new toy is annoying Alvin and Simon in 'Talking Teddy', then in 'Principal Interest', Alvin is none-too thrilled about going back to school, until he sees the new Principal. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Brittany takes up painting to impress her fashion idol in 'Art For Art's Sake', and then in 'Mancave', Alvin, convinced that Julie and her son are trying to move in, tries to stop it. (S1, ep 25)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin and Brittany give wildly differing versions of why the fire alarm went off in 'He Said She Said', then in 'Attack of the Zombies', Alvin and Theodore try to protect their loved ones. (S2, ep 23)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Brittany dreams of being a fashion designer in 'The Devil Wears Rodentia', then in 'Career Day', Alvin suspects Dave of being a local bank robber when Dave starts acting suspiciously. (S3, ep 22)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin packs a whole summer into one just day in 'Last Days of Summer', and in 'The Littlest Robot', Simon invents a robot with emotions and an ability to learn which quickly backfires. (S4, ep 21)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin talks Dave into a poor scheme in 'Tour Bus', then in 'Game Show', Alvin signs the Chipmunks up for a game show that forces losing contestants to perform dangerous stunts. (S4, ep 7)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin helps the mathletes stand up to the school bullies in 'Members Only', then in 'The New Kid', Alvin befriends a lonely new kidl, but the new student may not be who he says he is. (S2, ep 2)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: A new boy band tries to steal the spotlight in 'We're the Chipmunks', then in 'Save the Dance', the Principal gives Alvin & Derek an ultimatum - if they fight, the dance will be cancelled. (S2, ep 17)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin encourages Simon to write a frank email in 'Un-send!', then in 'The Orb', when Simon notices that Theodore has a hard time saying no, he creates the "No-Buddy". (S2, ep 12)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Chipmunks get stuck in traffic in 'Car Wars', then in 'Mr. Fix-It', Simon gets annoyed with everyone asking him to fix things so he decides to play dumb until he gets some thanks. (S5, ep 17)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin catches Simon taking a test to discover his soul-mate in 'Albrittina', then in 'Simon for President', Simon and Alvin decide to launch their own campaigns for class president. (S1, ep 6)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin must prove that alien life exists in 'Across the Universe', and in 'Britt's Picks', Brittany's furious when she thinks Alvin has been writing on her blog, and vows to get him back? (S3, ep 19)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Road Warrior / My Fair Chipette: More adventures with the pint-sized chipmunks. And Alvin, who is also a chipmunk, and therefore of broadly similar size.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Chipettes set out to prove that being a superhero isn't just a guy thing in 'Super Girls', then in 'Held Back', Alvin must pass his next test, or be separated from his brothers. (S2, ep 15)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon invents a device that can override the need to sleep in 'Dr. Sleep', then in 'Davey Boy', Alvin zaps Dave with a youth ray, turning him into an irresponsible teen. (S5, ep 6)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The boy's imaginations run wild when Dave disappears in 'Taken', then in 'The Flying Beast', Alvin tries to convince Dave that he's being hunted by a flying beast. (S5, ep 4)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave discovers he didn't graduate from high school and ends up in class with Alvin in 'Back to School', then in 'Bromance', Simon has found a new best friend, but then gets ditched. (S1, ep 16)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Brittany takes up painting to impress her fashion idol in 'Art For Art's Sake', and then in 'Mancave', Alvin, convinced that Julie and her son are trying to move in, tries to stop it. (S1, ep 25)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: When Alvin finally pushes Miss Smith too far, she quits in 'Missing Miss Smith', then in 'Monster Madness', Alvin and Simon tease The Chipettes about being scared by a movie. (S2, ep 14)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Derek plans a wild party at Alvin's house in 'Animal House Party', then in 'Dr. Zap vs Electroboy', Theodore is hit by lightning and believes he's like his comic book hero. (S4, ep 17)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin tells Theodore that he can turn rubbish into sweets in 'Alvin's Secret Powers', then in 'Warbie', The Chipmunks find a baby bird that's fallen from its nest. (S1, ep 24)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore mistakenly thinks he's the oldest brother in 'Big Bro Theodore', and in 'No Putts, No Glory', Alvin fools Theodore into believing he's good at mini golf which of course backfires. (S4, ep 10)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin suspects his neighbour is responsible for a recent heist in 'What A Gem', and in 'Family Spirit', Alvin tries to get out of the family picnic with Dave to go to a soccer game. (S1, ep 4)

programme.desc: Alvin encourages Simon to write a frank email in 'Un-send!', then in 'The Orb', when Simon notices that Theodore has a hard time saying no, he creates the "No-Buddy". (S2, ep 12)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: House Guest: Anxious to give Dave a much-needed rest, Alvin secretly decides to rent out their house for a Hawaiian home-swap. But the house guests show up early while Dave is still home! (S1, ep 40)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin's Got a Brand New Bag: When Alvin accidentally ruins Brittany's favourite new bag, he must come up with a way to replace this "one of a kind" fashion piece. (S1, ep 50)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Great Snack Off: Alvin and Theodore play a seemingly innocent game, which leads to unexpected consequences. (S5, ep 1b)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Taken: The boys' imaginations run wild when Dave disappears. When they finally find him, they're convinced he's a zombie. (S5, ep 4a)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin packs a whole summer into one just day in 'Last Days of Summer', and in 'The Littlest Robot', Simon invents a robot with emotions and an ability to learn which quickly backfires. (S4, ep 21)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Chipettes fall in love with a cute little mouse in 'Of Mice and Munks', and in 'Simon Saves the World', Simon's new invention creates a time loop and changing gravity inside the house. (S4, ep 24)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon invents a device that can override the need to sleep in 'Dr. Sleep', then in 'Davey Boy', Alvin zaps Dave with a youth ray, turning him into an irresponsible teen. (S5, ep 6)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Brittany hastily enters a skateboard contest in 'Skater Girl', then in 'All Washed Up', Simon's robot Geizmo goes around town dismantling washing machines, but is he actually helping? (S5, ep 15)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Chipmunks get stuck in traffic in 'Car Wars', then in 'Mr. Fix-It', Simon gets annoyed with everyone asking him to fix things so he decides to play dumb until he gets some thanks. (S5, ep 17)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theo's art project gains fans but then gets hacked in 'Mr. Lou', then in 'Love Song', Simon panics when Dave's song reveals his poem. (S5, ep 20)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Cheesy enlists Theodore and Alvin to steal desserts from the school kitchen in 'The Underground', then in 'Game House', Simon invents a virtual reality game that quickly gets out of hand. (S5, ep 25)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Squidward finds an unexpected pest at his hotel in 'Jolly Lodgers', then in 'Biddy Sitting', SpongeBob and Patrick get tricked into babysitting a grouchy old lady, who does all she can to escape.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Pearl stars in a guest appearance in 'Pearl Wants to Be a Star', then in 'Super Sitters', Patrick and SpongeBob go back in time to watch Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy when they were new. (S1, ep 12)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Pat The Hapless goes on a barbaric quest to the shopping mall in 'Chopping Spree', then in 'All Bot Myself', after Captain Quasar buys a new robot, Pat-Tron works for the Star family. (S3, ep 2)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: The campers meet two backwoods narwhals in 'Sugar Squeeze', then in 'Tag, You're It', On a rainy day, SpongeBob and his friends entertain themselves indoors with a turbulent game of tag. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Krabs reignites his passion for clowning in 'Krabsy the Klown', then in 'Lords of the LARP', Mo learns a new kind of fun and camaraderie. (S2, ep 8)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Plankton recruits Sandy to help in his lab in 'Mad Science Squirrel', then in 'To Pop a Bubble', SpongeBob's new friend proves unpopular at camp. (S2, ep 1)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob befriends a talking Krabby Patty whose only wish is to be eaten in 'My Friend Patty', then in 'Fun-Believable', Rube explores little known oddities and attractions around Bikini Bottom.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick and GrandPat try to pass each other on the stairs in 'Stair Wars', then in 'Enemies a la Mode', the members of the Star family each confront their own absurd rivalries. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: The Star family gets trapped in the bathroom in 'The Commode Episode', then in 'Tying the Klop-Knot', Bunny and Cecil need to have another Klopnodian wedding. (S2, ep 6)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: In 'Bubblestand' SpongeBob introduces his friends to the art of bubble blowing, and in 'Ripped Pants' SpongeBob tries to impress Sandy at Mussel Beach. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick and SpongeBob time-travel back to Viking times in 'Visiting Vikings', then in 'It's Too Late... With Plankton' Squidina hires Plankton to entertain the Lawnies. (S4, ep 12)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Bunny's mother visits from the old country in 'Which Witch is Which?', and then in 'Get Off My Lawnie', Granny Tentacles gets her own spin-off show. (S1, ep 25)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob shrinks the whole of Bikini Bottom in 'Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy IV', and then in 'Doing Time', Mrs. Puff is sent to prison when SpongeBob crashes his boat.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Camp Master Krabs hires the Flying Dutchman to run the camp store in 'Boo Light Special', then in 'Lake Crashers', The campers have a demolition derby under Lake Yuckymuck. (S1, ep 18)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: An unsatisfied anchovy strays from his brothers in 'What About Meep?', then in 'Hard Time Out', SpongeBob is sent to time out on behalf of his buddy, so Patrick does what he can to help. (S1, ep 7)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob's favourite jellyfishing net goes missing in 'The Pink Purloiner', and then in 'Squid Wood', SpongeBob decides that if he can't hang around with the real Squidward, he'll make his own.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Mr Krabs is messing up Pearl's preparations in 'The Slumber Party', and then in 'Grooming Gary', SpongeBob gives Gary a makeover, so that he can enter him in a pet show. But Gary's not so keen.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: The show finds an adorable new star in 'Patty-Poo', then in 'Swaptoberfest', the Star family swap identities. (S3, ep 7)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick ventures inside Cecil to learn how the body works in 'To Dad and Back', then in 'Survivoring', Cecil takes his kids camping, but Squidina wants the drama of reality TV. (S1, ep 9)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: The Great Patty Caper: SpongeBob, Patrick and Plankton solve a mystery on a runaway train.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Plankton teams up with Man Ray to take over the Krusty Krab and the world in 'Super Evil Aquatic Villain Team Up Is Go!', and in 'Chum Fricassee', Squidward quits the Krusty Krab to work for Plankton!

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: It's Kamp Koral's first ever Wild West Day in 'A Finful of Sand Dollars', then in 'Cretins of the Night', SpongeBob and Patrick become vampires for a night. (S2, ep 11)

programme.title: Beneath the Bun: Krabby Patty ...
programme.desc: ..Secrets: Uncover everything we know so far about the legendary Krabby Patty as Perch Perkins investigates the burger's history, ingredients, secrets, scandals and successes.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick hosts a time-travelling food show in 'Time to Eat', then in 'Cleaning House', while Bunny's in Klopnod, the Star home becomes a mess. (S2, ep 13)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: The Stars' neighbour Gladys is a local vigilante in 'Neighborhood Wash', then in 'A Fridge Too Far', Patrick, GrandPat, and Cecil want Bunny to honor their accomplishments on the fridge. (S5, ep 5)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Squidward's house becomes infested with a mail-order flea circus in 'Under the Small Top', then in 'Squidward's Sick Daze', Squidward fakes being sick, but SpongeBob arrives to care for him.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob tries to catch a Moon Jelly in 'Mooned!', then in 'Hysterical History', Sandy learns some Bikini Bottom history. (S14, ep 8)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: A tiny futuristic city exacts revenge on Patrick in 'The Wrath of Shmandor', and then in 'There Goes The Neighbourhood', Patrick and Squidina go on location to interview their neighbours. (S2, ep 4)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: The fire marshal forces Patrick to watch a safety training video in 'Safety Worst', then in 'De-Pat-ment Store', Patrick fails his way up the corporate ladder at Upturn's mall. (S4, ep 10)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick hosts an award ceremony in 'The Starry Awards', and then in 'Blorpsgiving', Captain Doug Quasar meets Pat-Tron's robot family. (S1, ep 23)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Patrick inducts SpongeBob into his society of dullards and doofuses in 'The Nitwitting', then in 'The Ballad of Filthy Muck', Patrick takes his grime to a new extreme, playing around in trash.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob mistakes an escaped convict for his driving instructor in 'The Getaway', then in 'Lost and Found', when Mr. Krabs sends him searching for a missing toy, SpongeBob finds himself lost too!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob volunteers to babysit 'Sandy's Nutty Nieces', then in 'Insecurity Guards', SpongeBob and Patrick volunteer as guards at the museum, while Squidward attempts to hang his painting unnoticed.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: When Squidward is hurt on the job, he threatens to sue Mr. Krabs in 'Accidents Will Happen', and in 'The Other Patty', Mr. Krabs and Plankton find a common enemy in the new 'Flabby Patty' restaurant.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Squidward cleans up the city of Bikini Bottom with help from SpongeBob in 'Keep Bikini Bottom Beautiful', and then in 'A Pal for Gary', SpongeBob brings Gary a pet that terrorizes him.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob is determined to find out everything there is to know about Vikings in 'Dear Vikings', and then in 'Ditchin', Patrick persuades SpongeBob to ditch class, but fun soon turns to guilt.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Pest Of The West: SpongeBob discovers that he was related to the great Western hero, SpongeBuck. Hired as the sheriff of Dead Eye Gulch, he must reclaim the town from no-good Dead Eye Plankton.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob finds out that Squidward has never tried a Krabby Patty in 'Just One Bite', and then in 'The Bully', SpongeBob is worried by a new pupil at boating school.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Mr Krabs loses SpongeBob to Plankton in a game of cards in 'Welcome to the Chum Bucket', and then in 'Frankendoodle', SpongeBob gets into a fight with a doodle of himself! (S2, ep 14)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Sandy is out of town for a few days so SpongeBob and Patrick are pet sitting for her in "Wormy", and then in "Patty Hype", SpongeBob invents a brand new culinary sensation! (S2, ep 5)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Mr Krabs opens the Krabbiest place on earth in 'Krabby Land', and in 'The Camping Episode', SpongeBob and Patrick decide to go camping - in the back yard.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob has trouble saying goodbye to the most perfect Krabby Patty he has ever cooked up in 'To Love A Patty', and then in 'Breath of Fresh Squidward', Squidward becomes the most jovial Squid ever!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob must find a new home for some unexpected guests in 'Pet Or Pests', and then in 'Komputer Overload', Plankton decides that he's had enough of Karen, and tries to replace her with a new model.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Sandy creates a new invention to avoid doing chores in 'Are You Smarter Than A Smart Cabin', and then in 'Deep Sea Despot', Squidward takes over as Camp Master. (S1, ep 22)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Patrick's dad unexpectedly visits Kamp Koral in 'Help Not Wanted', then in 'Camp Spirit', SpongeBob, Patrick and Sandy befriend a visiting ghost camper. (S1, ep 14)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: The weekly food delivery truck goes missing in 'Quest for Tire', and in 'A Cabin of Curiosities', a mysterious cabin of odd campers have frightful fun with SpongeBob and Patrick after dark. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: There is a certain amount of confusion, right away, in 'You Don't Know Sponge', and in 'Tunnel of Glove', SpongeBob and Pearl get stuck in the Tunnel of Glove, a romantic river ride at Glove World.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob and Patrick try to join the extreme sports team The Drasticals in 'Extreme Spots', and then in 'Squirrel Record', Sandy finds a book of world records and tries to break them all!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: When SpongeBob cooks at home, Mr. Krabs' customers leave his restaurant in 'SpongeBob's Place', then in 'Plankton Gets the Boot', Plankton gets kicked out of the house.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Gary's new habit causes a night of stress in 'Un-Breaking and De-Entering', then in 'Swimmin' Holed', Narlene and Nobby's secret swimming hole is exposed. (S2, ep 7)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: The Dinghies travel to outer space in 'Hats Off to Space', then in 'In a Nut's Shell', After discovering his empty shell, Narlene and Nobby disguise themselves at Camp Master Krabs. (S1, ep 26)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: We visit a town where the laws of logic no longer apply in 'SpongeBob in Randomland', then in 'SpongeBob's Bad Habit', SpongeBob can't stop biting his nails, but he also can't figure out why!

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick and Squidina report the news in 'Nitwit Neighbourhood News', then in 'Mid-Season Finale', The Patrick Show presents the epic conclusion to the first half of its first season. (S1, ep 13)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: A fitness variety show shows Patrick how to exercise in 'Star-Robics', then in 'Who's the Dummy Now?', a family of dummies move into the Star home. (S3, ep 3)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: The weekly food delivery truck goes missing in 'Quest for Tire', and in 'A Cabin of Curiosities', a mysterious cabin of odd campers have frightful fun with SpongeBob and Patrick after dark. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: SpongeBob and Patrick compete to be camp mascot in 'Mascot Mayhem', then in 'Putt Up or Shut Up', Krabs and Squidward play the most dangerous game. (S2, ep 9)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: The Dinghy cabin camps overnight without any water in 'High and Dry', then in 'The Beardsman', wilderness expert Paul Grunion visits the camp. (S2, ep 2)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob embarks on an epic journey to have his spatula reforged in 'Spatula of the Heavens', and then in 'Gary's Playhouse', SpongeBob builds a snail-house for Gary to play in while he is at work.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick loses the remote in the cushions, so journeys into the couch to find it in 'Lost in Couch', then in 'Pat-a-thon', Patrick hosts a telethon to raise money for snails who can't dance. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: After Patrick eats life-threatening chum, SpongeBob helps him with his 'Chum Bucket List', then in 'Big Baby Patrick', Patrick devolves back into a baby so he can keep his childhood toys. (S2, ep 7)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob and Patrick take Squidward 'Jellyfishing' and then in 'Plankton!' SpongeBob falls victim to one of Plankton's evil schemes. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick is mistaken for a corporate retreat leader in 'Retreat!', then in 'Sidekick Search', Patrick and Squidina hold auditions for a Patrick Show sidekick. (S5, ep 1)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Bubble Bass reviews The Patrick Show in 'Bubble Bass Reviews', and then in 'Patrick's Prison Pals', Bunny brings Patrick to prison for Bring Your Kid To Work Day. (S1, ep 26)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob and Patrick show Squidward a thing or two about snow in 'The Snowball Effect', and then in 'One Krab's Trash', Mr. Krabs accidentally sells a valuable hat to SpongeBob.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Squidward is determined for his cabin to win the annual camp art competition in 'Painting with Squidward', then in 'Kamp Kow', The Kamp Koral campers befriend a cow with a big appetite. (S1, ep 19)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Mrs. Puff gives swimming lessons to Patrick in 'Pat's A Li'l Sinker', then in 'Camp SpongeBob', SpongeBob finds himself all alone in the camp, but that doesn't stop him from having a blast. (S1, ep 8)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob is determined to have a great day in 'The Best Day Ever', and then in 'The Gift Of Gum', Patrick gives SpongeBob a gift - an enormous ball of used chewing gum. Best present ever?

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob becomes the richest Sponge in Bikini Bottom in 'Porous Pockets', and in 'Choir Boys', Squidward tries to avoid SpongeBob while on his way to an audition for the Bikini Bottom Men's Chorus.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick and Squidina go undercover to investigate a corrupt novelty product factory in 'Patrickle Jokes', then in 'Pat Roast', The Patrick Show presents The Roast of Patrick Star. (S3, ep 8)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: A classic villain returns to his former lair, only to find the Star Family inhabiting it in 'X Marks the Pot', then in 'Patrick's Alley', The Patrick Show rebrands for a younger audience. (S1, ep 11)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob and Patrick dig a tunnel between their two houses and drive Squidward nuts in 'That Sinking Feeling', and then in 'Karate Star', Patrick learns just enough karate to wreak havoc!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob and Patrick go on an advertising blitz in 'The Good Krabby Name', and in 'Move It or Lose It', Mr. Krabs and Plankton issue petitions to get their rival's restaurant bulldozed.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Sandy gets a brand-new suit in 'The Suit Suits You', then in 'Parasite Pals', SpongeBob's newest friend is a hungry parasite inside of him. (S2, ep 12)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: The Roxie sisters go their separate ways in 'A Tale of Two Roxies', then in 'Nite Owls', the Dinghy cabin kids discover life after dark. (S2, ep 5)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: The Stars celebrate Patrick's birthday at the Chum Bucket in 'The Fun Bucket', then in 'The Patrick Show After Dark', Patrick and Squidina explore Bikini Bottom late at night. (S3, ep 1)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick presents a show about food after missing out on a hearty breakfast in 'Late for Breakfast', then in 'Bummer Jobs', Patrick and SpongeBob experience the wonders of the workforce. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob and Patrick make it their mission to reunite a band in 'Goofy Scoopers', then in 'Pat the Dog', Patrick is sent to the dog pound, but he won't be able to leave until he's trained!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Snow Yellow: When Snow Yellow is deemed the "Squarest of them all", the evil Queen Karen seeks to claim the title for herself by any means necessary. (S14, ep 11)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick and SpongeBob work at the movie theatre to watch a new premiere in 'Movie Stars', then in 'Dr. Smart Science', Sandy helps Patrick to host a science show. (S2, ep 5)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick believes he's a medical professional in 'Doctor Patrick', and in 'Slumber Party Stars', after Pearl can no longer sleepover with Squidina, the Stars throw Squidina a slumber party. (S4, ep 11)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick gets a stunt double in 'Stuntin', and then in 'Olly Olly Organ Free', Patrick's organs leave his body in protest. (S1, ep 24)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Mr. Krabs turns the Krusty Krab into a jail after Plankton breaks the law in 'The Krusty Slammer', then in 'Pineapple RV', SpongeBob and Patrick turn the pineapple into a mobile home for a road trip.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Patrick has a coupon for free ice cream in 'Patrick's Coupon', then in 'Out of the Picture', Mr. Krabs buys Squidward's art, but wants to make a profit on his purchase.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob breaks his precious alarm clock in 'Broken Alarm', and then in 'Karen's Baby', Karen quickly learns that kids grow up too fast after her new child arrives in the mail.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Instead of paying to fix a hole in the wall, Mr. Krabs instead opens up a 'Drive-Thru', and in 'The Hot Shot', Tony Fast Jr., the son of a famous race car driver, teaches SpongeBob how to drive.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob and Patrick buy a toy and have to learn to share it in 'Yours, Mine and Mine', and then in 'Kracked Krabs', SpongeBob goes with Mr. Krabs to the Cheapest Crab Convention.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Mr Krabs must pretend to be a pirate for a visiting relative in 'Grandpappy The Pirate', and in 'Cephalopod Lodge', SpongeBob and Patrick accidentally get Squidward expelled from a secret society.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: It's a battle of the restaurants in '20,000 Patties Under The Sea', and then in 'The Battle Of Bikini Bottom', Patrick and SpongeBob discover that they have very different views about cleanliness.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: In 'The Nasty Patty', SpongeBob thinks a Krabby Patty has caused the health inspector to meet an early end, then in 'The Idiot Box', SpongeBob shows Squidward about imagination.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.title: Premier League Years 2022-2023
programme.desc: Revisit the annals of Premier League history with the 2022-2023 season, a campaign that saw Manchester City and Pep Guardiola rewrite what is possible in English club football.

programme.title: PL Retro: Liverpool v Chelsea 2014
programme.desc: Relive the classic clash between Liverpool and Chelsea from the 2013-14 season at Anfield. The Reds needed to win to stay on track for a first Premier League title.

programme.title: PL Greatest Games:Man U/Bolton '01
programme.desc: Bolton: Enjoy the greatest Premier League game for each of the league's 47 clubs, as voted for by fans. Here, for Bolton Wanderers, the 2-1 win over Man Utd at Old Trafford back in 2001.

programme.title: PL Greatest: Bolton/Chelsea 2005
programme.desc: Chelsea: Enjoy the greatest Premier League game for the league's 49 clubs, as voted for by fans. For Chelsea, the win over Bolton in 2005 that won the Blues their first title in 50 years.

programme.title: PL Greatest Games:Spurs/Arsenal'04
programme.desc: Remember a classic match from the Premier League. Here, Arsenal head to White Hart Lane back in 2004, looking to secure the Premier League title.

programme.title: PL Greatest:A Villa/B'Ham City '08
programme.desc: A chance to relive a Premier League classic. Here, Aston Villa enjoy a 5-1 win over Midlands rivals Birmingham at Villa Park back in 2008.

programme.title: Best Premier League Goals 99/00
programme.desc: Relive some classic action from the Premier League archive.

programme.title: PL Legends: Sol Campbell
programme.desc: Series profiling some of the greatest players to grace the Premier League. Here the focus is on former Tottenham Hotspur and Arsenal defender Sol Campbell.

programme.title: PL 100: David James

programme.title: PL Greatest Games:M City/L'Pool 15
programme.desc: Relive a Premier League classic, as Man City face Liverpool back in November 2015. City needed a win to go back top of the table, while Liverpool were adapting to life under Jurgen Klopp.

programme.title: PL Greatest Games:M City/L'Pool 13
programme.desc: Relive a Premier League classic, as Man City face Liverpool back in 2013. City needed three points to close the gap at the top to Man Utd, while the Reds were chasing a top four spot.

programme.title: PL Greatest Games:Man U/L'Pool '95
programme.desc: A look back at some classic matches in the Premier League. Here, Man United host Liverpool in October 1995, as Eric Cantona returned from his lengthy suspension in a thrilling 2-2 draw.

programme.title: PL Greatest Games:L'Pool/Man U '97
programme.desc: A look back at some classic matches in the Premier League. Here, Liverpool meet Manchester United at Anfield in 1997, in a match that had a happy outcome for the Red Devils.

programme.title: PL 100: Dion Dublin

programme.title: Naíonáin an Zú
programme.desc: Sraith faoin saol mar atá sé ag ainmhithe nuabheirthe in dhá zú i mBeirlín na Gearmáine. (This series discovers what it takes to be a baby in a modern zoo.)

programme.title: Seal le Dáithí
programme.desc: Is é Fiachna Ó Braonáin an chéad aoi den tsraith. (Fiachna Ó Braonáin is Dáithí Ó Sé's guest in the first episode of the series.)

programme.title: Malcolm in the Middle
programme.desc: Imíonn Lois nuair a dhéanann na buachaillí praiseach dá lá breithe. (Lois leaves when the boys demolish any hopes for a happy birthday.)

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Filleann Maggie as Ceanada agus iarrann sí ar Cliff í a phósadh. (Maggie returns from Canada and asks Cliff to marry her.)

programme.title: Geantraí
programme.desc: Is as teach tábhairne O'Rourke i bPáirc Kilburn i Londain a chraolfar Geantraí na hoíche anocht. (This week's Geantraí is coming to you from O'Rourkes in Kilburn Park, London.)

programme.title: Murder, She Wrote
programme.desc: Caitheann Jessica an t-am ag iarraidh ainm a heagarthóra a ghlanadh ó tharla dúnmharú a bheith curtha ina leith. (Jessica winds up trying to clear her editor of the murder.)

programme.title: Domhan an Dúlra
programme.desc: Clár faisnéise faoi na scileanna atá ag ainmhithe chun teacht slán tríd an ngeimhreadh. (Learn about the survival skills animals have, that help them get through the winter.)

programme.title: Taste of Australia with Hayden Quinn
programme.desc: Réitíonn Hayden bricfeasta do ghardaí tarrthála. (Hayden cooks up breakfast for some lifeguards.)

programme.title: Ceol Tíre ón nGrianán
programme.desc: Is é George Hamilton IV a bheidh ag gabháil fhoinn ar an gclár seo as Amharclann an Ghrianáin. (George Hamilton IV takes the stage at An Grianán Theatre.)

programme.title: The Gilmore Girls
programme.desc: Ní oibríonn plean Lorelai & Rory amach do chóisir na gcearc do Lane. (Lorelai & Rory's plans for a bachelorette party for Lane go awry.)

programme.title: An Aimsir Láithreach
programme.desc: Aimsir réigiúnach agus náisiúnta. (National and regional weather.)

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Filleann Maggie as Ceanada agus iarrann sí ar Cliff í a phósadh. (Maggie returns from Canada and asks Cliff to marry her.)

programme.title: Nuacht Cúla4
programme.desc: Clár nuachta do dhaoine óga ina gclúdaítear scéalta áitiúla, náisiúnta agus idirnáisiúnta. (News programme for young people covering local, national and international news.)

programme.title: Club Airéine
programme.desc: Fáilte chuig an Airéine! Is iad na páistí ó Chlub Gleacaíochta iFit as Corcaigh a bheidh linn an tseachtain seo. (This week, we're with kids from iFit Gymnastics Club in Cork.)

programme.title: Is Mise le Mess
programme.desc: Tá scothfhoireann Is Mise le Mess ar ais do shraith nua! Téann an triúr chuig teach Mhíchíl 'Toose' Mhic Gearailt. (The mighty Is Mise le Mess team return for a brand-new series!)

programme.title: An Aimsir Láithreach

programme.desc: Caitear súil ar an méadú atá tagtha ar speicis Ionracha sa Spáinn sa gclár faisnéise seo. (This documentary explores how invasive species in Spain have rapidly multiplied.)

programme.desc: Ag triall ar Ráth Chairn arís is léir gur éirigh thar barr le Féile na Gealaí. (In our second visit to Ráth Chairn, we see that Féile na Gealaí was a roaring success.)

programme.title: Modesty Blaise
programme.desc: 1966. Action. Director: Joseph Losey. Stars Monica Vitti, Dirk Bogarde & Terrence Stamp. A spy spoof in the 60s tradition with comic book heroine, Modesty Blaise. Set in the Italian Mediterranean.

programme.title: Maybe I'll Come Home in the Spring
programme.desc: 1971. Director: Joseph Sargent. Stars Sally Field, Eleanor Parker & Lane Bradbury. Dennie learns that the hippie lifestyle isn't as glamorous as it seems and comes home to judgement.

programme.title: Blood Of The Vampire
programme.desc: 1958. Horror. Directed by Henry Cass and starring Sir Donald Wolfit. In the late 19th Century, the anaemic Dr Callistratus is the governor of a brutal penal institution in a remote castle.

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Reluctant Widow. 1963. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt & Christopher Guinee. Meeting at Scotland Yard, Bob helps Cork on a poisoning case of a young woman and a rich man.

programme.title: Burke's Law
programme.desc: Who Killed Davidian Jones? 1964. Stars Gene Barry, Gary Conway & Regis Toomey. Millionaire Davidian Jonas is found attached to his boat. Amos investigates.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Ring of Wax. 1966. Stars Adam West, Frank Gorshin & Linda Scott. Batman and Robin attempt to stop The Riddler from stealing a Lost Incan treasure and are led to Madame Soleil's wax museum.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Give 'em the Axe. 1966. Stars Adam West, Linda Scott & Frank Gorshin. Batman and Robin escape from the vat of boiling wax while the Riddler goes after the sarcophagus at the Gotham City museum.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: The Case of the Violent Suitor. 1955. Stars Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford & Archie Duncan. Advice columnist 'Aunt Lottie' is at risk after advising a woman to break up with her fiancee.

programme.title: The Spiritualist
programme.desc: 1948. Thriller. Director: Bernard Vorhaus. Stars Turhan Bey, Lynn Bari & Cathy O'Donnell. Christine thinks she can hear her late husband calling out of the surf on the beach one night.

programme.title: A Little of What You Fancy
programme.desc: 1968. A loving tribute to British Music Hall with Lily Morris & Gus Elen. Featuring original archive film, rare prints, portraits and photographs, it traces what remains of the great music halls.
